package postgres

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

// ScanRowToMap scans a row with given field descriptions into a map.
func ScanRowToMap(rows pgx.Rows) (map[string]any, error) {
	fieldDescs := rows.FieldDescriptions()
	values := make([]any, len(fieldDescs))
	valuePtrs := make([]any, len(fieldDescs))

	for i := range values {
		valuePtrs[i] = &values[i]
	}

	if err := rows.Scan(valuePtrs...); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := make(map[string]any, len(fieldDescs))
	for i, fd := range fieldDescs {
		name := string(fd.Name)
		val := values[i]

		// Convert special types to JSON-serializable values
		switch v := val.(type) {
		case [16]byte:
			// UUID type - convert to string format
			result[name] = formatUUID(v)
		case time.Time:
			result[name] = v
		case *time.Time:
			if v != nil {
				result[name] = *v
			} else {
				result[name] = nil
			}
		case []byte:
			// Check if it's 16 bytes (could be UUID)
			if len(v) == 16 {
				var uuid [16]byte
				copy(uuid[:], v)
				result[name] = formatUUID(uuid)
			} else if json.Valid(v) {
				// Check if it's valid JSON
				result[name] = json.RawMessage(v)
			} else {
				result[name] = string(v)
			}
		default:
			result[name] = val
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}

// formatUUID converts a 16-byte array to UUID string format.
func formatUUID(uuid [16]byte) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s-%s-%s",
		hex.EncodeToString(uuid[0:4]),
		hex.EncodeToString(uuid[4:6]),
		hex.EncodeToString(uuid[6:8]),
		hex.EncodeToString(uuid[8:10]),
		hex.EncodeToString(uuid[10:16]),
	)
}
